recipe_inventory.label: Ethylenediamine route, 120 °C/6 h

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 1 (printed p. 82), Experimental section.
Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 83), Results and Discussion.

recipe_inventory.scope: CdCl2·2.5H2O and Se powder, amounts described as appropriate but not quantified; fill 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless autoclave to 80% with ethylenediamine; add unquantified excess Na immediately before a 120 °C/6 h hold; naturally cool, collect dark-red precipitate, sequentially wash with absolute ethanol and distilled water, vacuum dry 80 °C/2 h.
gaps: Cd and Se charges/feed ratio; Na amount; pressure and heating ramp not reported.

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 83), Results and Discussion.

qualitative_contexts.scope: Slight excess Na is described as essential; excess Se is difficult to remove and leaves strong XRD Se reflections; >160 °C or >12 h is reported to leave yield/quality unchanged but increase particle size, while lower temperature/shorter time gives incomplete reaction. These are qualitative statements without per-condition product/sample values and are not separate pairs. Benzene/toluene/THF comparisons lack exact route conditions.
